Based on StPageFlip 2.0.7 by Nodlik, distributed under the MIT license.
Upstream: https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
Local reader changes: sinusoidal easing, consistent full-turn duration across viewport sizes,
explicit final animation frame, monotonic start timestamp, and page-position progress events.
These motion values are local ebook choices, not official Apple animation specifications.

2026-09-10 alignment revision: hard pages and shadows honor the centered render rectangle;
subpixel time interpolation and an edge-to-edge curved leaf trajectory;
geometry-based cover centering during drag and cancellation; fractional page bounds;
correct programmatic flip hit coordinates; restrained hard-cover shadows.

Shadow refinement: the soft leaf inner shadow uses a single monotonic falloff,
instead of repeated dark bands. Book contact and gutter shading live in the reader UI.
